title: Pectin Use in Pediatric Intestinal Rehabilitation
brief_summary: Pediatric short bowel patients, age 6 months to 21 years old, followed in our intestinal rehabilitation clinic, will be screened for qualification in the study. If meets qualification, will be consented for the study. The study involves patients receiving green beans in their diet for three months with data collection including stooling patterns as well as labs, and then switching over to liquid pectin for three months. Again data collection will take place. The duration of the study once patient is consented is \~6 months.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* Short bowel syndrome patients followed in CIRCLe
* \>=50% of colon remaining
* Patients requiring only enteral feeds for nutrition
* \>=6 months of age-21 years of age

Exclusion criteria:

* Patients with major structural cardiac anomalies and/or end stage renal disease
* Patients with solid organ transplant
* Patients \>24 months of age without gastric tube
* Short bowel patients on PN
